name: Glass Health
tagline: Ambient AI scribe and clinical decision support that drafts notes and differentials for clinicians.
description: Glass Health is a clinical AI platform for physicians that pairs an ambient scribe with decision support: it listens to a visit and drafts the note, then generates three-tier differential diagnoses and assessment-and-plan suggestions with PubMed-cited reasoning. Clinicians review, edit, or reject every suggestion — it is positioned as a reasoning aid, not a diagnostic replacement. Higher tiers integrate with EHRs including Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, and Elation.
insight: A Y Combinator (W23) company; its decision support rests on guidelines peer-reviewed by an in-house academic physician team.
edge: Goes beyond note-taking to active diagnostic reasoning, pairing the ambient scribe with cited differentials — where most AI scribes stop at documentation.
pros: Ambient scribe plus clinical decision support
Three-tier differential with a can't-miss tier
cons: A reasoning aid, not a diagnostic authority
Full EHR integration only on top tier

references.title: Glass Health is building an AI for suggesting medical diagnoses
